extension_requires: Previous level complete with unchanged numerical gates, dt/cache full-window comparison, no wall correction, <5% Rg cost, predicted next triple <180s and remaining campaign budget. Fresh integration from t=0 at every level; no stitching.
initial_graph: d <= 2.1R; contact d <= 2R+1nm; proximity not fusion
formation_rule: new edges persistent >=0.2ms (exploratory) and separately original 2ms persistence, lower components, relative Rg reduction>=1%, endpoints and edge events agree under dt/cache; not physical fusion
world_model_gate: at least 3 independent training initial states plus held-out initial states and held-out actions; converged, distinct centroid AND shape responses >=5x measured numerical differences; local normalized response rank>=3 for joint position-shape model; no random time-sample split
